title: Boxing Baby Sequence
description: Four sequential panels show a baby wearing a full-body onesie and boxing gloves in dynamic fighting poses against a bright pink background. The black and white illustrations are arranged horizontally within a white frame, layered over translucent film strips bearing the repeated text 'STAY' on a vibrant magenta surface.
prompt: A horizontal sequence of four black and white illustrations of a fierce baby wearing a tight onesie and oversized boxing gloves, shown in various fighting stances with mouth open. Each panel has a solid bright pink background, all contained within a clean white rectangular frame. The artwork is layered over translucent strips with bold black text reading STAY, set against a vivid magenta surface.
